title: Nilitimiza miaka ishirini huko Clark na watu wengi walisherehekea nami

text.I turned twenty in Clark and a lot of pe: Nilitimiza miaka ishirini huko Clark na watu wengi walisherehekea nami
text.On my twentieth birthday, a lot of diffe: Katika siku yangu ya kuzaliwa ya ishirini, watu wengi tofauti walisherehekea nami.
text.I worked at a language school, so everyo: Nilifanya kazi katika shule ya lugha, kwa hiyo kila mtu alisherehekea pamoja nami: walimu, wafanyakazi wengine wa Korea na mameneja kutoka nchi nyingine.
text.(It seems I deleted the photos and video: (Inaonekana nilifuta picha na video za wakati huo kimakosa.)
text.At night, after work, we all went to a r: Usiku, baada ya kazi, sote tulienda kwenye mkahawa.
text.They reserved the whole restaurant, and: Walihifadhi mkahawa wote, na watu wengi kutoka kazini kwangu walisherehekea pamoja nami.
text.I was very happy, and I still remember i: Nilifurahi sana, na bado nakumbuka vizuri.
text.That day, I drank a lot, ate a lot of ca: Siku hiyo nilikunywa pombe nyingi, nikala keki nyingi na chakula kitamu cha Korea.
text.Even looking back now, I think I was giv: Hata ninapokumbuka sasa, nafikiri nilipewa tukio la thamani sana.
text.The boss worried about me being the only: Bosi alikuwa na wasiwasi kuhusu mimi kuwa Mjapani pekee hapo
